user.title: Lights
user.description: Choose the RGB light to drive and any follower lights.

data.fixed_fade: Fixed colour fade (0 = use hue speed)

data_description.mode: The effect used when the light is turned on without one.
data_description.hue_speed: How fast the hue moves, in degrees per second.
data_description.max_step: Largest hue change per command, in degrees. Above 4° looks visibly jumpy. Limits the hue speed and the shortest Rainbow lap.
data_description.fixed_fade: If above 0, every colour change takes exactly this long instead of using the hue speed.
data_description.min_jump: Smallest Drift hue change, in degrees.
data_description.max_jump: Largest Drift hue change, in degrees.
data_description.momentum: Chance (0 to 1) that Drift keeps going the same way round the wheel.
data_description.rainbow_lap: Seconds for one full Rainbow lap. Raised automatically if the lights cannot keep up.
data_description.brightness_fade: Default seconds for a brightness change.

data_description.scale: Fraction of the primary brightness (0.1 to 1.0).
data_description.offset: Degrees added to the Rainbow hue for this light.

error.primary_is_follower: The primary light cannot also be a follower.
error.jump_range: The minimum jump cannot exceed the maximum jump.

set_brightness.name: Set brightness
set_brightness.description: Update the brightness target of an ambient light. Fades to it if the cycle is running; never turns the light on or resumes a paused cycle.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Target brightness, 0 to 100 percent (0 is treated as 1 %).

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Fade length in seconds. Defaults to the configured brightness fade.
